head: iPhone 18 delay may be tied to Samsung camera sensors, report says
dek: Japan's Semicon Portal reports that Apple may be waiting for Samsung's Texas factory to make enough camera sensors for the standard iPhone 18, which didn't launch with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo. Apple hasn't explained the delay.
details: Samsung reportedly began prototyping the sensors this year in Austin, Texas, with mass production expected in the fall. The standard iPhone 18 is now expected in the first half of 2027, possibly with the iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2. Reports of a split launch go back to May 2025, before the prototyping began, so the sensor link isn't confirmed. Apple has long bought its camera sensors from Sony.
where: Rumor; standard iPhone 18 expected in the first half of 2027
means: If you're waiting for the regular iPhone 18 rather than a Pro, plan on next year, not this one.
todo: Nothing to do yet; if you need a phone now, the current models are what's on sale.
